config.dire_difficulty.title: Dire Difficulty
Picking a preset writes its values into every setting on the other tabs. Change any of those afterwards and the preset becomes Custom — there is no hidden layer, what the config file says is what runs.
config.dire_difficulty.preset.tooltip: Selecting a preset stamps every setting it governs. Editing one of those afterwards switches this to Custom.
config.dire_difficulty.scoreAdvancements: Measure progress by completed advancements. Recipe unlocks don't count. Works with no other mods installed.
config.dire_difficulty.scoreArchetypes.t: Measure progress by your Archetypes level. Ignored entirely — not counted as zero — when Archetypes isn't installed.
config.dire_difficulty.scoreSkillProfici: Measure progress by your total skill levels. Ignored entirely — not counted as zero — when Skill Proficiencies isn't installed.
config.dire_difficulty.combineMode.toolt: How the sources that can answer are folded into one score. Only sources that answered are combined.
config.dire_difficulty.advancementTarget: Completed advancements that count as fully progressed.
Total Skill Proficiencies levels that count as fully progressed. Their ceiling is 1500 (15 skills at 100).
config.dire_difficulty.spawnRateProgress: Extra spawn rate at full progression
Adds this fraction to the spawn frequency as progression rises. 0 keeps spawn rate independent of progress.
config.dire_difficulty.elitePlate.toolti: Show the elite's name, health and affixes at the top of the screen while your crosshair is on it. Display only — this setting is yours, not the server's, and no preset changes it.
config.dire_difficulty.eliteGearDrops.to: Let an elite's worn weapon and armour drop, rarely and damaged, exactly like ordinary mob gear. Off means elites never drop what they're wearing. Their rarity loot is separate and unaffected, netherite armour never drops either way, and anything a mob picked up still comes back.
config.dire_difficulty.allMobGearDrops.t: The master switch: off, no naturally spawned mob drops worn equipment, elite or not. Items a mob picked up off the ground are never suppressed — those are yours.
config.dire_difficulty.eliteChanceMax.to: Share of natural monster spawns that become elites once you're fully progressed. Starts near 1% in a fresh world and ramps late.
config.dire_difficulty.maxRarityTier.too: 1 Uncommon, 2 Rare, 3 Epic, 4 Legendary. Locking a rarity raises the ones below it rather than producing fewer elites. Loot follows rarity.
config.dire_difficulty.legendaryWeightFl: Minimum draw weight for Legendary regardless of progression. 0 leaves it on the normal curve, where it's genuinely absent early.
Extra affix points on top of each rarity's budget. The exclusion rules and both hard guarantees still apply.
config.dire_difficulty.bonusAffixSlots.t: Extra affix slots on top of each rarity's slot count.
config.dire_difficulty.bonusFromRarityTi: Lowest rarity the two bonuses above apply to. 1 Uncommon, 4 Legendary.
config.dire_difficulty.allowedAffixClass: Leave empty to allow all. Otherwise a whitelist of: OFFENSE, DEFENSE, CONTROL, MOBILITY, AURA, SUPPORT, UTILITY, DEATH.
config.dire_difficulty.daySpawning.toolt: Opens the light gate for hostile spawning. Surface monsters still need open sky, so a lit base stays safe.
config.dire_difficulty.daySpawnBurnImmun: Stops sunlight burning while daylight spawning is on. Without it, day spawns die within seconds and the setting above does nothing.
config.dire_difficulty.spawnFrequencyMul: Natural spawn attempts per chunk, as a multiplier. 1.0 is exactly vanilla.
How many monsters the world will hold, as a multiplier. Affects both the world-wide and the per-chunk limit.
config.dire_difficulty.despawnDistanceMu: How far monsters follow you before despawning, as a multiplier. Below 1 they clear out sooner; above 1 they stick around.
config.dire_difficulty.theHunt.tooltip: Nearby monsters with nothing else to do come looking for you. They walk — nothing teleports, and terrain still works as cover.
Nothing here yet. Every knob lives on one of the tabs above.
